task: Testing drawings — UI-only modeling and raw export parity

scope.creationAndExport: All CAD geometry and exports were produced through visible UI controls and normal keyboard/pointer events. DOM inspection and one control-focus operation aided browser automation; no modeling API, app internal geometry call, or FeatureScript constructed either model.
scope.offlineVerification: Raw files were copied unchanged, compared byte for byte and hashed. Separate read-only STEP/DXF geometry inspection did not replace the raw comparison.

finalResult.geometry: After explicit axis correction, all four exported solids are valid in OCCT 8.0. Pairwise bidirectional Boolean differences have zero volume at OCCT tolerances; maximum bounding-coordinate difference is about 1e-7 mm. This is not byte equality.
finalResult.dxf: Both contain four LINE entities forming the 20 × 20 mm rectangle. Ordering, line direction, floating-point text, metadata and line endings differ.

sketch.constraints: Width and height dimensioned; Chili3D reported 0 DOF / fully constrained. Onshape display units were inches but all dimensions were entered explicitly in mm.

corrections: Initial circular-pattern exports had different placements: an offset vertical edge was selected in Onshape and a dynamic plane was inferred in Chili3D. This is recorded as a selection/workplane mismatch, not proof of a kernel defect.

Kept the cached Onshape exports. Recreated the Chili3D circular pattern through the UI with center (0.5, -0.5, 0), fixed XOY working plane and 180-degree spacing; moved the copy +Z 20 mm. The initial files and inspection remain in initial-run/.
Restored Chili3D's dynamic working-plane preference after the correction.

exportSettings.chili3dStep: Export .step, Merge checked, 4 selected parts; OCCT AP214 output

caching: Onshape STEP and DXF were each downloaded once after the Onshape model was complete and cached without rewriting.
limitations: Only this testing specimen and these command paths were exercised; this is not full UI conformance coverage.
Shell and array workflows do not retain the same editable feature tree in Chili3D.
A native project download initially stalled during a session with concurrent development rebuilds; reopening the saved document and retrying succeeded. Cause not isolated.
Development compile overlays from unrelated workspace changes interrupted the run; no unrelated source files were modified.
